posts.body:
Personally, I think you're very close. You just need to check for tile passability before you do the "moveStraight" command. RPG Maker already comes with default:
JavaScript:
$gameMap.isPassable(x, y, direction)
The "direction" in this case refers to the tile's passability direction, not the character's. (Like passable only from above, below, etc.)
